about: ImageDraw.polygon(xy, fill=..., outline=...) and outline alone: the outline is 1 px lines from vertex to vertex, drawn after the fill (reelkit.fx.starburst draws its ink stars so, on an RGBA image)
note: args: mode and size (width, height) of the image, background (its one colour before the call) or the array "in", xy as passed (xy_form "pairs": a list of (x, y) tuples; "flat": one list x0, y0, x1, y1, ...), then the keyword arguments of the call exactly as passed (a keyword that is absent was not passed). Floats are float.hex() strings. Arrays are (height, width) for L and F, (height, width, 3) for RGB, (height, width, 4) for RGBA; F is float32. Pillow truncates every coordinate toward zero to a C int before drawing, and an F ink to float32.
